steps.step: SR1 synthetic exactly gapless double star (Delta^2 = 0) with a common-mode noise shared by the points of each chain: the joint-covariance fit contains Delta^2 = 0 in its 2 sigma interval at the nominal rate (the size of the under-coverage of a diagonal-error fit depends on the correlation structure; here it is moderate -- a covariance-free fit is not accepted in any case)
